meta.title: Forma Tak | Vote & Win a Free One-Day Intensive Course
meta.description: Vote for your favorite technology topic at the Forma Tak stand and enter our daily raffle to win a free full-day course.

hero.hook: Shape the Training. Win the Knowledge.
hero.prizeSentence: Vote for your preferred tech topic and enter the prize draw to win a free one-day intensive course on the winning subject.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tap your favorite course topic below to cast your instant vote.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Enter your contact details to participate in the exclusive raffle.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Winners are drawn live at the stand to receive full-day course passes.

voting.title: Choose Today's Winning Course Topic
voting.subtitle: Tap a topic card to vote instantly. Results update live.
voting.offlineNotice: You appear to be offline. Please check your internet connection.
voting.voteError: Could not record vote. Please try again.

topic-a.title: Applied AI & LLMs in Production
topic-a.tagline: Practical generative AI, prompt engineering, and LLM integrations
topic-a.description: Master building, evaluating, and deploying production AI systems with robust retrieval-augmented generation and API orchestration.

topic-b.title: Cloud Architecture & Modern DevOps
topic-b.tagline: Containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and high-availability systems
topic-b.description: Learn Kubernetes fundamentals, automated testing pipelines, and cost-efficient multi-cloud deployment strategies.

topic-c.title: Cybersecurity & Threat Defense
topic-c.tagline: Penetration testing, application security, and incident response
topic-c.description: Protect enterprise web applications and network perimeters against modern attack vectors and data breaches.

results.title: Live Stand Results
results.subtitle: Updated every 5 seconds from stand votes

cta.headline: Want a chance to win a free one-day course on {topic}?
cta.subtext: The topic with the most votes wins. Register now before the end-of-day draw!
cta.alreadyRegistered: Already registered? You're all set for the draw!

register.title: Enter the Prize Draw
register.subtitle: Register your details in 30 seconds. One entry per visitor.
register.phoneHint: Must be an active Algerian mobile number (Ooredoo, Mobilis, or Djezzy)
register.emailHint: We will email you course materials if you win
register.consentLabel: I agree to be contacted if I win the raffle and consent to event communications.
register.duplicatePhone: This mobile number is already registered for today's draw. Good luck!
register.genericError: Registration could not be completed. Please try again or visit the stand desk.

success.title: You're In the Draw!
success.message: Thank you for participating! The lucky winners will be drawn live at the stand at the end of the day.
success.prizeReminder: If your chosen topic wins, you will receive a free seat in the one-day intensive course.
success.whatNextStep1: Keep your phone handy around closing time when we draw winners.
success.whatNextStep2: We will call or message winners directly with access instructions.
success.changeVoteNote: Want to support another topic? You can still cast more votes.

validation.name_min: Full name must be at least 2 characters

validation.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address

admin.title: Stand Administration
admin.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your authorized admin credentials
admin.unauthorized: Access restricted: Your account does not have administrative permissions.
admin.raffleSubtitle: Randomly select winners for the free course from registered visitors.
admin.resetConfirmDesc: This will clear all existing winners from the database and restart the draw from Round 1. This action cannot be undone.
admin.fewerEligibleWarning: Notice: Only {count} eligible participants remained. All remaining participants were drawn.
admin.noEligibleLeft: All registered participants have already won! Register more visitors to draw more.
